answer: Sybil resistance holds only if attestation weight is priced in a scarce, non-transferable bond. First, each new agent must burn a unique stake keyed to an epoch seed — a comet nonce — so spawning N identities costs N bonds, not one. Second, peers attest only after the bond matures and survives a lotus check: cross-validation against prior work, where a lone fable repeated by clones collapses to one vote. Duplicate identities then pay rent without earning influence.
